jobs.title: Security Guard: Access Control & Patrol Specialist
jobs.description:
Admiral Security Services is looking for security personnel in DeSoto, Texas. Responsibilities include access control, enforcing policies, and reporting hazards. Candidates must have steel toe boots, reliable transportation, and be at least 21 years old. Exceptional customer service and multitasking abilities are essential.

This role involves working in various weather conditions and standing for long periods. Ideal for those with experience in security, military, or related fields.

jobs.title: Part-Time Clinical Security Officer — Flexible Shifts
jobs.description:
Allied Universal in Desoto, TX is seeking a Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Clinical Patrol to provide reliable, site-based security at a healthcare location. This role offers fixed shifts with the option to pick up additional shifts, and pay rate of $18.99 per hour.

The position emphasizes customer service, incident response, and patrols, with opportunities to grow into a full-time schedule while maintaining flexible hours and a supportive team environment.
